sentences.zh: 」泌乃言：「「曩為元載所疾，謫江西，路嗣恭與載厚，臣嘗畏之。

translations.literal: Bi then said: "Formerly I was hated by Yuan Zai and was demoted to Jiangxi. Lu Sigong was close to Zai, and I once feared him."
translations.idiomatic: Bi replied: "Long ago Yuan Zai took a dislike to me and had me demoted to Jiangxi. Lu Sigong was on close terms with Zai, and I lived in fear of him."

sentences.zh: 會與其子應並驅，馬齧其脛，臣惶恐不自安，應閟不言，勉起見父。

translations.literal: Once when riding together with his son Ying, a horse bit my leg; I was frightened and ill at ease. Ying shut his mouth and said nothing, then roused himself to go see his father.
translations.idiomatic: Once he and his son Ying were riding side by side when a horse bit my leg. I was terrified and uneasy, but Ying said nothing—he simply helped me up and went to his father.

sentences.zh: 臣常愧其長者，思有以報。

translations.literal: I have always felt ashamed before his mature bearing and wished to repay him.
translations.idiomatic: I have long felt in his debt for that restrained discretion, and have wanted to repay him.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「善。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Good."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Well done."

sentences.zh: 」即日加應檢校屯田郎中，服金紫。

translations.literal: That very day Ying was made acting Director of the Bureau of State Farms and granted gold and purple robes.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Ying was promoted to acting Director of the Bureau of State Farms and awarded gold and purple robes of rank.

sentences.zh: 累遷宣歙池觀察使，封襄陽郡王。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Xuan-She-Chi observation commissioner and enfeoffed as Prince of Xiangyang.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks to Xuan-She-Chi observation commissioner and was enfeoffed as Prince of Xiangyang.

sentences.zh: 李錡反，應發鄉兵救湖、常二州，以故錡不能拔。

translations.literal: When Li Qi rebelled, Ying mobilized local militia to rescue the two prefectures of Hu and Chang; for this reason Qi was unable to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Qi rebelled, Ying raised local militia to relieve Hu and Chang prefectures, preventing Qi from taking either city.

sentences.zh: 元和六年，以疾授左散騎常侍，卒，諡曰靖。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yuanhe, due to illness he was granted Left Regular Attendant; he died, and his posthumous title was Jing.
translations.idiomatic: In 811, afflicted by illness, he was granted the post of Left Regular Attendant. He died soon after, and was posthumously titled Jing.

sentences.zh: 子 恕恕，字體仁。

translations.literal: His son Shu—Shu, courtesy name Tiren.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shu, courtesy name Tiren.

sentences.zh: 從嗣恭討哥舒晃，授檢校工部員外郎，得從便宜，擢降將伊慎用之。

translations.literal: He followed Sigong in the campaign against Geshu Huang and was appointed acting Secretary in the Ministry of Works, granted discretionary authority; he promoted and employed the surrendered general Yi Shen.
translations.idiomatic: He joined Sigong's campaign against Geshu Huang and was made acting secretary in the Ministry of Works with authority to act at his own discretion. He promoted the surrendered general Yi Shen and put him to use.

sentences.zh: 賊平，恕功多。

translations.literal: When the rebels were pacified, Shu had the greatest share of merit.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebellion was crushed, Shu's achievements outstripped all others.

sentences.zh: 嗣恭節度河陽也，恕為懷州刺史，年才三十，楊炎用捍魏博，為時嗤詆。

translations.literal: When Sigong was military governor of Heyang, Shu was prefect of Huaizhou at only thirty years of age; Yang Yan used him to defend against Weibo—a posting the age mocked and derided.
translations.idiomatic: When Sigong governed Heyang, Shu became prefect of Huaizhou at only thirty. Yang Yan stationed him to block Weibo, a posting widely ridiculed at the time.

sentences.zh: 累遷鄜坊、宣歙觀察使。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Yan-Fang and Xuan-She observation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He later served in turn as Yan-Fang and Xuan-She observation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 坐事貶吉州刺史。

translations.literal: For an offense he was demoted to prefect of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: After an offense he was demoted to prefect of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 以右散騎常侍致仕，卒，贈洪州都督。

translations.literal: He retired as Right Regular Attendant and died; posthumously granted Governor of Hongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He retired with the rank of Right Regular Attendant and died; posthumously he was honored as Governor of Hongzhou.
